description: Developer-first error tracking, performance monitoring, and application debugging platform
auth_notes: Supports OAuth2 (authorization code and device flow), internal integration auth tokens (Bearer), user auth tokens, and legacy API keys.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free developer account/plan self-serve and generate auth tokens or internal integrations immediately.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST API v0 covering organizations, projects, issues, events, releases, teams, and user configurations.
mcp_notes: Sentry provides official MCP support ('MCP access' is listed as part of its developer plan and platform features).
rationale: Sentry provides a broad public REST API, flexible authentication methods, and free self-serve developer tier credentials, making it fully ready to build an agent toolkit today.

evidence.note: Details on Bearer tokens, internal integrations, user tokens, and OAuth2/device authorization flows.
Shows the free Developer plan allowing solo developers to sign up and access platform features including MCP/API.
Describes the Sentry web API surface for managing account-level resources, data, and organizations.
Indicates official MCP access included in plans.
